lines.en: You came! I was not sure you would.
lines.hi: Tum aa gaye! Mujhe yakeen nahi tha.

lines.en: I said I would. I keep my word.
lines.hi: Maine kaha tha na. Main apna vaada nibhata hoon.

lines.en: Then come on. The whole town is waiting!
lines.hi: To chalo. Poora sheher intezaar kar raha hai!
